register.name: ADFE_RAM_POWER_SEQ
register.comment: RAM power controls for sequencing ON->OFF OFF->ON ON->RET and RET->ON. Shared between all power sequencers these fields set the RAM power up/down sequences. This varies with SoC technology node. For 8nm, in each three bit field, bit 2 is unused, bit 1 is PDE and bit 0 is RETN, normally 0b011 for power off, 0b001 for power on. For 5nm and 4nm, in each three bit field, bit 2 is unused, bit 1 is PDE and bit 0 is RET, normally 0b010 for power off, 0b000 for power on.

register.name: DFE_SIGGEN_CONFIG_I2[0]
register.comment: Register to control operation of the internal signal generator. SigGen must be enabled in DFE_SIGGEN_ENABLE to start

register.name: DFE_SIGGEN_CONFIG2_I2[0]
register.comment: Register to control operation of the internal signal generator - logical extension of DFE_SIGGEN_CONFIG

register.name: DFE_SIGGEN_FREQ_I2[0][0]
register.comment: This sets the frequency of each tone used by the signal generator. The value for a given frequency can be found by multiplying by 65_536 and dividing by the sample rate of the injection point. When multiple tones are enabled, output will be scaled down automatically to avoid clipping.

register.name: DFE_SIGGEN_FREQ_I2[0][1]
register.comment: This sets the frequency of each tone used by the signal generator. The value for a given frequency can be found by multiplying by 65_536 and dividing by the sample rate of the injection point. When multiple tones are enabled, output will be scaled down automatically to avoid clipping.

register.name: DFE_SIGGEN_PHASE_I2[0][0]
register.comment: This register has several functions: It is the phase value preloaded into the accumulator used to generate each tone, except the last tone. The last tone always starts with phase 0. Register index 0 is used to provide the DC level in DC output mode. It also affects I and Q phases in pseudo-random signal mode.

register.name: DFE_RX_STATUS_I3[0]
register.comment: Rx path status and latency measurements

register.name: DFE_RX_LNA_PHASE_COMP_CONFIG1_I3[0]
register.comment: Configuration for LNA phase compensation - WL LNA.

register.comment: Configuration for LNA phase compensation - WL LNA.

register.name: DFE_RX_NOTCH_CONFIG_I3[0]
register.comment: This register configures the two notch filters in each of the receive chains. The lower 8 bits configure the OFDM filter and the next 8 bits the CCK filter.

register.name: DFE_RX_NOTCHA_DC_OFFSET_I3[0]
register.comment: This register configures the fixed dc offset to apply before the NOTCHA filter. The lower 8 bits configure the I offset and the next 8 bits the Q offset.

register.name: DFE_RX_NOTCHA_STATUS_I3[0]
register.comment: Rx status of notch filter A (OFDM) in each of the receive chain.

register.name: DFE_RX_NOTCHB_STATUS_I3[0]
register.comment: Rx status of notch filter B (CCK) in each of the receive chain.

register.name: DFE_RX_NOTCH_PRELOAD_I3[0]
register.comment: Sets values to be loaded into the memory element of the notch filters at the start of each frame.

register.name: DFE_SIGANAL_CONFIG_I3[0]
register.comment: This register configures the signal analyser

register.name: DFE_SIGANAL_FREQ_I3[0][0]
register.comment: This signed value sets the frequencies of the tones used by signal analyser channels. The value for a given frequency can be found by multiplying by 65_536 and dividing by 160_000_000 eg for a tone of 5MHz program to 5*10^6 * 65536 / 160 * 10^6 = 2048
